about: The Claude Code version this plugin was last tested on, and every name the plugin relies on in it (hook events and fields, frontmatter keys and values, tools, env). Interactive users run their own version, so `version` is a floor to warn below (scripts/doctor.sh), never a pin. scripts/claude-code-contract.py checks the names against that version's real binary; tests/test_claude_code_contract.py fails when the plugin uses a name the contract does not list. On a new Claude Code: run `diff <old> <new>`, re-verify every entry with `semantics`, then bump `version`.

Grep.meaning: Left out of the default tool set on macOS, Linux and WSL (offered on Windows); Claude searches with find/grep through Bash, which reach hooks as Bash calls. It comes back for a subagent only when that subagent lists Grep or Glob and leaves out Bash. Every cc-fuzzer agent lists Bash, so on Linux they search with Bash; never write a prompt that needs Grep.

SubagentStop.meaning: hooks/ledger-append.sh reads agent_transcript_path to record the subagent's measured tokens.

additionalContext.meaning: PostToolUse/SessionStart output added to the model's context (detect-crashes.sh, env-check.sh).

stop_hook_active.meaning: True while Claude Code is already continuing because a Stop hook blocked. Claude Code advises letting the turn end then, and overrides a hook after CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP (default 8) consecutive blocks. hooks/sweep-gate.sh blocks again only after progress, at most 3 times.

PostToolBatch.meaning: Fires once after all tool calls of one response have finished (input has tool_calls); present since 2.1.165. Duplicate calls in one response run in parallel, their PreToolUse hooks concurrently. hooks/dedup-calls.sh clears its per-response batch here.

ScheduleWakeup.meaning: Sets the next iteration of a self-paced /loop, or ends it with stop: true. YOLO therefore runs as `/loop /cc-fuzzer:tick` started by /cc-fuzzer:yolo on; only the main thread calls it.

run_in_background.meaning: Agent tool input. A subagent spawned from the main conversation runs in the background by default, so the tick skill dispatches the orchestrator with run_in_background: false to get its YOLO_NEXT line in the same turn.

history.note: first contract, 2026-10-05; the ParallaxCRS images pin the same version
2026-10-29: YOLO runs as a self-paced /loop (ScheduleWakeup's documented use); the tick skill dispatches the orchestrator with run_in_background: false; Grep/Glob semantics re-verified.
